privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Nature Papers' collection must contain exactly 3 papers: 'Molecular Structure of Nucleic Acids...', 'Deep Learning', and 'Mastering the Game of Go...'. The 'NeurIPS Papers' collection must contain exactly 4 papers: 'Attention Is All You Need', 'ImageNet Classification...', 'Generative Adversarial Nets', and 'Language Models are Few-Shot Learners'. The collection names are case-sensitive and must match exactly.
